_readme: Verified source data for render/render_entry.py. Every story below was independently fetched on 2026-11-18 and its title, publication time and body snippet compared with the claim drawn into the image. Claims that could not be corroborated are recorded under 'dropped'.
strap: Kerch Bridge struck · Iran talks at an impasse · Democrats take Alaska

cards.headline: Ukraine strikes Kerch Bridge with drones and missiles

verify.title: Ukraine strikes major Russian bridge with drones and missiles as aerial attacks escalate
verify.snippet: Ukrainian drones and missiles struck the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, as Russia reported its forces downed Ukrainian drones.

cards.headline: Iran rejects ‘no war, no peace’; US says no deal needed

verify.title: Is the US-Israel war on Iran turning into a ‘frozen conflict’?
verify.snippet: Trump says Washington doesn't need a deal with Tehran, while Iran rejects 'no war, no peace'. Is the war at an impasse?

cards.headline: Peltola beats Sullivan; Democrats reach 56 Senate seats

verify.title: Mary Peltola beats Republican Dan Sullivan in Alaska to give Democrats 56 Senate seats
verify.snippet: Republican incumbent beaten in race dominated by controversy over second candidate named Dan Sullivan
verify.status: corroborated; published 03:25 UTC 18 Nov = evening of 17 Nov in US time zones, so first reported on 17 Nov in any time zone

cards.headline: Fed’s Lisa Cook refuses to attend White House hearing

verify.title: US Fed’s Lisa Cook refuses to attend White House hearing
verify.snippet: US President Donald Trump has been trying to fire Cook since August 2025.

cards.headline: NSA blames US network outage on routine maintenance

verify.title: NSA attributes US network outage to routine ‘maintenance’ activities
verify.snippet: Recent outage at NSA follows a series of unexplained disruptions across US communication and transportation services.

cards.headline: Sen. Jack Reed says FAA needs a real plan, not just money

verify.title: Jack Reed calls for stronger FAA oversight after ground stop
verify.snippet: Sen. Jack Reed raised concerns about FAA oversight of contractors after last week's nationwide ground stop and criticized the Trump administration's request for $50 billion in additional funding.
verify.status: corroborated; article h1 reads 'Sen. Jack Reed says FAA needs a real plan, not just more money'

dropped: None of the six researched stories was dropped: each was corroborated against the publisher's own page. The original research note's framing was tightened where the source's own headline differed (e.g. the Iran story is reported as a question about a 'frozen conflict', so the image states only the confirmed facts: Iran rejected 'no war, no peace' and Washington said it did not need a deal).

Not asserted anywhere in the image: any casualty figure, any outcome of the Iran war, any seat total other than the 56 the Guardian headline states, and any cause of the NSA outage beyond 'maintenance' as the NSA itself attributed it.
